## a worktree is removed only on proof its branch landed

ID: `prune-merged-worktrees/a-worktree-is-removed-only-on-proof-its-branch-landed`

Status: **implemented and tested**

`scripts/prune_merged_worktrees.py` SHALL remove a linked worktree and its branch only when the forge shows a merged pull request for that exact branch whose merge commit is on the local default branch, or when merging the branch into the default branch would change no file. Every other worktree SHALL be kept and printed with the reason. A path given with `--exclude` SHALL be kept even when proven merged; `--dry-run` SHALL remove nothing; `--help` and any unknown flag SHALL remove nothing.
